A.name: Version 5 Bridge Train A
A.purpose: Restore trust in the delivery loop

cars.name: live checkout and coordinated freshness truth
cars.acceptance_gate: Operator, controller, PM, and Builder must observe the same checkout identity and freshness facts before mutating workflows begin. Reports and gates only; does not auto-checkout.

cars.name: updater ownership and authored-data preservation
cars.acceptance_gate: Classify product-owned, generated, and operator-authored paths explicitly; never delete/overwrite authored state; produce actionable blocked result when reconciliation is required.

cars.name: wrap intent, artifact admission, and honest cancellation
cars.acceptance_gate: Intent is explicit, unsupported cancellation is honest, tracked-file admission is a positive decision, unavailable draft preservation fails visibly, and successful wrap binds to the exact final publication consumed by the next launch while exposing stale/fallback provenance before action. Engine portability is required: wrap gates must be classified as portable (always run) or provider-specific. Provider-specific required methodology gates return CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE and block completion/release authority, but MUST NOT block a state-only checkpoint, durable handoff, safe wrap, or engine replacement. Round-trip preservation is required: unsupported attempts treat PRAWDUCT state as dormant/read-only; on return to Claude, reattach and run /prawduct:doctor to restore methodology authority safely.

cars.name: exact release proof and workflow supply-chain floor
cars.acceptance_gate: Release cannot publish unless the exact approved SHA was tested and tag dereferences to it; privileged dependencies are immutable and mechanically checked.

cars.name: atomic rule authority
cars.acceptance_gate: Rule approval/replacement are versioned atomic transitions. Cannot leave contradictory rules active or approve content different from reviewed snapshot.

exit_gate: Every car has independent tests and review evidence.
Live installation reports exact checkout and release identity.
Failure-injection rehearsal proves updater preservation, wrap intent, release SHA binding, and atomic rule replacement.
Release and deployment explicitly initiated after integration candidate is frozen.
Project Manager performs state-only final checkpoint with no surprise repository PR.
Operator receives one consolidated decision at genuinely privileged boundary.

B1.name: Version 5 Hotfix B.1
B1.acceptance_gate: Require explicit server-side caller/project/group authorization; deny bare or unbound enumeration; prevent cross-group document and absolute-path disclosure. Cover authorized same-group, missing binding, invalid binding, and cross-group tests. Preserve supported callers or migrate them explicitly. Leave current main releasable.

B2.name: Version 5 Train B.2
B2.investigation_note: Not conclusively probed due to destructive action requirement. Treat as fail-closed. Requires non-destructive fixture/test-harness probes and independent admission decisions.

B3.name: Version 5 Train B.3
B3.investigation_note: Verified not actively reachable on this installation right now, but not closed globally.
